subject: Hospitality
title: AI in Event Planning
description: A short lesson to help you apply AI in Event Planning.

hook.text: AI now matches attendees for networking, predicts attendance, optimizes pricing, and generates personalized itineraries.

buildup.text: AI-powered matchmaking analyzes attendee profiles and suggests connections based on shared interests, industries.

discovery.text: Predictive analytics forecast registration patterns, enabling dynamic pricing: early-bird rates rise as demand signals increase.

twist.text: AI-generated event content—session summaries, social posts, follow-ups—saves planners hours but raises authenticity questions.

climax.text: AI handles logistics; humans handle experience. The tech works best when it automates the boring so humans do the meaningful.

punchline.text: AI matches, predicts, prices, and writes. Planners are freed to create—not administrate.

quiz.question: How does AI improve event networking?
options: It analyzes profiles and suggests connections based on shared interests and goals
